# Mabel Colby

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v3 c35 P1](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** Student, former schoolteacher  <sub>[v2 c26 P9](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0009), [v3 c35 P1](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Mabel is a striking, dark-eyed girl who is considered very attractive and won the beauty prize among the Second Year classes at Regent's Academy. She is described as having a "rose-red" appearance.

_Sources: [v1 c22 P0](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0000), [v1 c24 P2](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0002), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Personality

Mabel is a creative and driven student who shares a close, kindred-spirit friendship with Nell and Honora. Despite her striking beauty, she possesses deep, yearning dreams and imaginations. At times, she can be pragmatic and slightly sarcastic, particularly regarding social matters and schoolwork.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c26 P9](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0009), [v3 c38 P15](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0015)_

- Creative and imaginative  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>

- Teaching  <sub>[v2 c26 P9](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0009)</sub>

## Goals

- Complete her studies at Regent's Academy and Wexcombe College  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c26 P9](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0009)</sub>
- Win the Johnson Scholarship in Mathematics  <sub>[v1 c26 P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002)</sub>

## History

Mabel Colby attended Regent's Academy in the same year as Nell Harcourt, where she became a close friend to Nell and Honora Hollis and won the Second Year class beauty prize. After completing her studies at Regent's, she spent two years instructing at a small, isolated rural school. Weary of country teaching and boarding, she proposed that she, Nell, Honora, and Cressida Lindsay rent a house together in Portmaris to attend Wexcombe College, with her Aunt Euphemia acting as housekeeper. They successfully leased 'Tabby's Place' on Linden Avenue, where they lived together while attending Wexcombe. After completing her studies, Mabel eventually relocated to Vancouver to work as a schoolteacher.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v2 c26 P9](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0009), [v2 c26 P13](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0013), [v3 c10 P36](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0036), [v3 c36 P23](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0023)_
